subject: general
question: A bus covers 1200 km in 30 hours. What is its average speed in m/s?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the bus = 1200 km

Time taken = 30 hours

**Concept Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

Convert the speed from km/h to m/s:

1 km/h = 1000 m / 3600 s

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed (in m/s) = (Distance in km × 1000) / (Time in hours × 3600)

**Calculation:**

Average Speed (in km/h) = 1200 km / 30 hours

⇒ Average Speed (in km/h) = 40 km/h

Convert 40 km/h to m/s:

⇒ Average Speed (in m/s) = (40 × 1000) / 3600

⇒ Average Speed (in m/s) = 40000 / 3600

⇒ Average Speed (in m/s) ≈ 11.11 = 11 (1)/(9) m/s

**∴ The average speed of the bus is approximately 11 (1)/(9) m/s.**
